exceptions.justification: CodeRabbit reviews pull requests as a GitHub App; its CLI is not run inside the CI contract job.
exceptions.ruleBroken: CodeRabbit findings must be addressed or recorded before merge.
exceptions.attempted: Running the CodeRabbit CLI in the workflow, which needs a CodeRabbit API key that is not issued to CI.
exceptions.constraint: In CI the review is the GitHub App's; the CLI only reviews uncommitted local edits.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The App's review threads are resolved on the pull request before merge, so its findings still block.
exceptions.residualRisk: A finding the App never raised is not seen; the same is true of any reviewer.
exceptions.revisitWhen: CodeRabbit ships a CI mode for the CLI, or the App is uninstalled.

exceptions.justification: The one-page brief is added by this change and is published by the Pages deploy that follows the merge to main, so https://maverickcer.github.io/data-cap/brief.html returns 404 until then.
exceptions.attempted: Checked that docs/brief.html exists on this branch and is linked from docs/index.html; the live URL cannot resolve before the deploy.
exceptions.constraint: GitHub Pages serves only what the deploy job publishes from main, and the deploy runs after the merge.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The alternative is to omit the link to the page from the landing page for the one deploy that precedes it.
exceptions.residualRisk: If the page is never published, the link stays broken; the next DocsLinks run after the deploy would report it.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The deploy that follows the merge has run; remove this record then.

exceptions.justification: ci/size-budgets.mjs is added by this change, so the link to it on the main branch returns 404 until the change is merged.
exceptions.attempted: Checked that ci/size-budgets.mjs exists on this branch and that the link names the path it will have on main; the live URL cannot resolve before the merge.
exceptions.constraint: A blob link on the main branch resolves only to files that are on main, and the file arrives with this change.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The alternative is to link a branch-specific URL that would break after the branch is deleted, or to drop the link for one release.
exceptions.residualRisk: If the file is later renamed without updating the link, it stays broken; the first DocsLinks run after the merge would report it.
exceptions.revisitWhen: This change has been merged to main; remove this record then.
